messages.subject: Objetive function value of 0
parts:
Hi folks,

I'm working through the oSCR bookdown (which is amazing!) and have gotten to section 4.2 - the design-finding algorithm. Things seem to be running fine, but when I view the iterations and diagnostic plots, I keep getting "best OF value = 0" and my plot of objective function value against generation is a flat line at 0.

I've tried messing with the parameters (beta0, sigma, GA settings...) just to get things to work, but no change.

I'm curious if anyone has encountered this before? Or if I might have made an error somewhere along the way?

Happy to share my code where needed.

Best,

Jamie

Thanks for sharing, Jamie.

Error in if (.) . > 1 else { : argument is not interpretable as logical
In addition: Warning message:
In rbinom(K, 1, pmat[i, j]) : NAs produced

 The simulation does run when I use sigma in km, but it takes a very, very long time (and I have yet to run it through completely).

Not totally sure what the issue is here... Happy to share my code again!

Thanks so much for your help -

Jamie
